1.name: Napalm
1.text: Spew an incendiary mixture, dealing spirit damage, applying slow, and coating targets in napalm.

1.name: Flame Dash
1.text: Dash forward, gaining slow resistance while leaving a flaming trail that deals spirit damage over time. Hold [W] while active to dash farther.

1.name: Afterburn
1.text: Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing spirit damage over time. Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.

1.name: Concussive Combustion
1.text: Become a living bomb, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to all nearby enemies after a delay. Once cast, Concussive Combustion cannot be interrupted.

2.name: Lightning Ball
2.text: Shoot a ball of lightning that travels in a straight line. Does damage to all targets in its radius. Slows down when damaging enemies and stops if it hits the world.

2.name: Static Charge
2.text: Apply a charge to a target enemy hero. After a short duration, the static charge stuns and damages enemies within the radius.

2.name: Power Surge
2.text: Power up your weapon with a shock effect, making your bullets proc shock damage on your target. This shock damage bounces to enemies near your target. Occurs once per burst shot.

2.name: Storm Cloud
2.text: Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight.

3.name: Stake
3.text: Throw a stake that tethers enemies to the location where the stake lands. Enemy movement is restricted to the length of the tether.

3.name: Flight
3.text: Leap into the air and fly. While in flight your weapon deals bonus spirit damage and your items have increased range.

3.name: Crow Familiar
3.text: Your crow familiar deals impact damage, reduces their bullet resist and applies a bleed that deals damage based on the target's current health.

3.name: Assassinate
3.text: Use your scoped rifle to fire a powerful shot over long distances. Deal only partial damage until fully charged after 1.0s of being scoped. Does bonus damage to enemies with less than 50% health remaining. Landing a killing blow on a player with Assassinate grants you bonus weapon damage.

4.name: Essence Bomb
4.text: Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time. Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated.

4.name: Life Drain
4.text: Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you. Target must be in line of sight and within max range to drain. You can shoot and use other abilities during the drain, but your move speed is reduced. to give health to friendly Heroes.

4.name: Malice
4.text: Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.

4.name: Soul Exchange
4.text: Swaps health levels with an enemy target. There is a minimum health percentage that enemies can be brought down to and a minimum amount of health received based on victims current health.

6.name: Siphon Life
6.text: Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

6.name: Shoulder Charge
6.text: Charge forward, pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies stun. If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.

6.name: Infernal Resilience
6.text: Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary regeneration for a portion of the damage taken.

6.name: Seismic Impact
6.text: Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying stun.

7.name: Card Trick
7.text: Deal weapon damage to summon cards of a random suit. Each card can be thrown, dealing damage and applying a different effect depending on its suit. Cards thrown fly towards the enemy or point under your crosshair. Alt-cast to throw first card

7.name: Full Auto
7.text: Temporarily boost your fire rate and deal bonus spirit damage

7.name: Telekinesis
7.text: Lift an enemy hero into the air and then slam them towards the target location.

8.name: Mini Turret
8.text: Deploy a turret that shoots enemies, dealing spirit damage over time. The turret expires after a limited lifetime. Turrets deal reduced damage to troopers and objectives.

8.name: Medicinal Specter
8.text: Deploy a spirit that provides healing to nearby allies.

8.name: Spectral Wall
8.text: Cast a wall that applies slow on enemies it passes through. Erupt the wall to divide the terrain in half and damage nearby enemies. After casting, press or Ability 3 to erupt the wall early. Can be Destroyed with Melee Attacks

8.name: Heavy Barrage
8.text: Unleashes a volley of rockets that home in on a targeted location. McGinnis is slowed and is still able to use stamina.

10.name: Pulse Grenade
10.text: Throw a grenade that begins pulsing when it lands. Each pulse expands the radius and applies spirit damage, time slow, and stacking increased damage for Paradox against the victim.

10.name: Time Wall
10.text: Create a time warping wall that stops time for all enemy projectiles and bullets that touch it and increases the speed and damage of friendly bullets. Enemies that touch the wall will be briefly slowed.

10.name: Kinetic Carbine
10.text: Charge up a powerful shot of time energy, dealing spirit damage and applying a Time-Stop to enemies hit. The damage dealt increases with weapon damage. Move speed is increased while charging. While in the air and charging, to timeslow your movement.

10.name: Paradoxical Swap
10.text: Fire a projectile that swaps your position with the target enemy hero.

11.name: Kinetic Pulse
11.text: Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying knockup.

11.name: Quantum Entanglement
11.text: Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use. : Bring nearby allies with you.

11.name: Rejuvenating Aurora
11.text: While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby. You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.

11.name: Singularity
11.text: Create a singularity in your hands, dealing spirit damage over time, applying stun, and pulling in nearby enemies.

12.name: Frost Grenade
12.text: Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that heals allies and applies spirit damage and move speed reduction to enemies.

12.name: Ice Path
12.text: Kelvin creates a floating trail of ice and snow that gives movement bonuses to him and his allies. Kelvin gains 60% slow resistance for the duration. Enemies can also walk on the floating trail. Press Dash / Crouch / slide to travel up or down while in Ice Path.

12.name: Arctic Beam
12.text: Shoot freezing cold energy out in front of you, damaging targets and progressively reducing their movement and fire rate the longer you sustain the beam on them. You have reduced move speed while using Arctic Beam. The beam may also claim Souls.

12.name: Frozen Shelter
12.text: Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid regeneration and enemies are slowed. Objectives become Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter

13.name: Sleep Dagger
13.text: Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.

13.name: Smoke Bomb
13.text: Fade out of sight, becoming invisible and gaining sprint speed. Attacking removes invisibility, but using items does not. Close enemies can see through your invisibility.

13.name: Fixation
13.text: Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target. Gain one stack per bullet hit, three if the hit is a headshot.

13.name: Bullet Dance
13.text: Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.

14.name: Powder Keg
14.text: Throw a barrel that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage, setting enemies on fire and applying knockup. The barrel can be detonated early by being shot, melee'd, or detonated by another barrel. The burn stacks, so overlapping barrels burn for their combined damage. Can be Alt-Cast to place the barrel in front of Holliday.

14.name: Bounce Pad
14.text: Drop a bounce pad in the world that launches any hero. You explode on landing, dealing Damage to any nearby enemies. The explosion can only occur once per person per Bounce Pad.

14.name: Crackshot
14.text: Headshots deal bonus Damage and applies a Fading Move Speed penalty. This effect can only occur when off cooldown. Cooldown is reduced by 50% on NPC hits. Crackshot ignores range damage fall-off and does not apply to objectives.

14.name: Spirit Lasso
14.text: Throw out your lasso, dealing spirit damage, pulling, and applying stun. Using a Bounce Pad extends the duration of Spirit Lasso.
numbers: Extended Duration from Bounce Pad: 1.25 s

15.name: Exploding Uppercut
15.text: Deal melee damage to nearby enemies and apply knockback. When they land, they deal spirit damage and apply reduced fire rate to other nearby enemies. Exploding Uppercut can be used on allies.

15.name: Sticky Bomb
15.text: Attach a bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage to nearby enemies. If the bomb hits or kills a hero, you gain permanent bonus damage on Sticky Bomb. Stacks diminish by half after 60 hits and 7 kills

15.name: Grapple Arm
15.text: Launch out a mechanical hand that pulls the first character it hits, reeling them in. Grapple Arm can be used on allies.

15.name: Hyper Beam
15.text: Channel a powerful torrent of energy that deals spirit damage and applies slow.

16.name: Gloom Bombs
16.text: Throw a cluster of bombs that detonate after a delay, dealing spirit damage. Enemies hit by multiple bombs take 65% damage.

16.name: Leaping Slash
16.text: Dash forward before slashing all enemies in a circle, dealing melee damage. If the ability hits at least one hero, heal a small amount of health.

16.name: Ava
16.text: Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain bonus move speed that increases over time, and become hidden on the minimap. Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.

16.name: Return to Shadows
16.text: Instantly turn to shadows, becoming untargetable, gaining bonus move speed, and dealing spirit damage. After a delay, return from the shadows, dealing spirit damage again.

17.name: Charged Shot
17.text: Charge up a powerful shot that pierces through enemies. Hold Ability 1 or to hold the shot.

17.name: Rain of Arrows
17.text: Launches you high in the air, allowing you to glide slowly. While airborne, you gain Weapon Damage and multishot on your weapon. for reduced jump height. Press Jump / mantle to cancel the glide.

17.name: Spirit Snare
17.text: Throw out a trap that begins to arm itself. Once armed, the trap will trigger when an enemy enters its radius, applying Curse and Movement Slow that interrupts, Silences, Disarms, and prevents item usage. Hit the trap with a Charged Shot to detonate early with increased radius.

17.name: Guided Owl
17.text: After 1.5s cast time, launch a spirit owl that you control and which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies. Hold [W] to accelerate the owl. Press Jump / mantle to release control. Gain permanent Spirit Power for each enemy hero killed with Guided Owl.

18.name: Scorn
18.text: Deal damage to nearby enemies and heal yourself based on the damage done. Heal is stronger against enemy heroes.

18.name: Burrow
18.text: Burrow underground, moving faster, and gaining spirit and bullet armor. Damage from enemy heroes will reduce the speed bonus. When you jump out, deal spirit damage, slow, and knockup.

18.name: Sand Blast
18.text: Spray sand that disarms enemies in front of you and deals damage.

18.name: Combo
18.text: Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.

19.name: Serrated Knives
19.text: Throw a knife that bleeds an enemy. Each additional hit adds a stack and refreshes the bleed duration, causing the bleed to increase per stack.

19.name: Slice and Dice
19.text: Perform a dash forward, damaging enemies along the path. Hit Enemies have their spirit resist reduced. This debuff can stack.
tiers: +2 s Cooldown Reduced on Hero Hit
+1 s Cooldown Reduced on Non-Hero Hit

19.name: Bloodletting
19.text: Take only a portion of incoming damage immediately and defer the rest to be taken over time. Activate to clear a portion of the deferred damage.

20.name: Entangling Thorns
20.text: Summon a patch of choking thorns that damages and slows enemies in its radius.

20.name: Kudzu Connection
20.text: Connect with a nearby ally to gain bonuses, replicated healing, and ignore the move speed penalty while shooting. Receive 50% of Bonuses with no connection Connection requires line of sight.

20.name: Stone Form
20.text: Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.

20.name: Air Drop
20.text: Grab an ally and take flight with them. Drop your ally to cause an explosion, dealing spirit damage. You and your ally gain increased Outgoing Damage when flying ends. Cooldown reduced by 30% when used on allies. Taking damage briefly disables using the ability. While lifted, your ally cannot attack and deals -20% damage.

25.name: Alchemical Flask
25.text: Throw a flask that damages and reduces the weapon damage and move speed of enemies it hits.

25.name: Willpower
25.text: Gain a Barrier and bonus move speed.

25.name: Binding Word
25.text: Curse an enemy hero. If they don't move away from their initial position within the escape time, they will be damaged and immobilized.

25.name: Last Stand
25.text: After charging for 2s, release pulses that damage enemies and heal you based on the damage done. While channeling Last Stand you have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist. Immune to fear while Last Stand is active.

27.name: Power Slash
27.text: Channel to increase damage over 1.4 seconds, then release a fully-charged sword strike. Press Ability 1 or to trigger the strike early, dealing partial damage.

27.name: Flying Slash
27.text: Throw a grappling hook to reel yourself towards an enemy, dealing melee damage and slowing the target when you arrive.

27.name: Crimson Slash
27.text: Slash enemies in front of you, damaging them and slowing their fire rate. If any enemy heroes are hit, you heal.

27.name: Shadow Transformation
27.text: Become infused with Yamato's shadow soul. After an initial invincible transformation your abilities are refreshed and are 60% faster. You gain immunity to negative status effects and have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist. When you get a hero kill, you heal and the duration is extended.

31.name: Ground Strike
31.text: Stomp the ground beneath you, damaging enemies in front of you. If you perform Ground Strike while airborne, you quickly dive towards the ground. Damage grows slower after 25m.

31.name: Grapple
31.text: Pull yourself through the air toward a target. Using Grapple also resets your limit of air jumps and dashes.

31.name: Flog
31.text: Strike enemies in front of you with your whip, healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

31.name: Death Slam
31.text: Focus on enemies to connect whips to them. After channeling, connected enemies are lifted and stunned then slammed into the ground. Your victims and any enemies in the landing zone will be damaged and slowed. Press to throw connected enemies early. Enemies that are not in line of sight or go out of range during the latch time will not be grabbed.

35.name: Splatter
35.text: Throw a ball of goo that deals damage and leaves puddles of goo behind that apply movement slow to enemies in the radius.

35.name: The Cube
35.text: Encase the target in a cube of restorative goo that protects from damage, and increases health regen. Target is unable to take any new actions while cubed. Can be used on self. Press Jump / mantle to escape early.

35.name: Puddle Punch
35.text: Materialize a fist in the world that punches everyone in the area, applying knockup. Punching an enemy deals melee damage and applies slow. Enemies can Parry this attack. You and your allies have increased Air Control.

35.name: Goo Ball
35.text: Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact. The ball grants large amounts of Bullet and Spirit resist, bounces off walls and can double jump.

50.name: Barrage
50.text: Channel to start launching projectiles that deal spirit damage and apply slow around their impact point. Projectiles that hit a hero grant Pocket increased damage that stacks. Casting while airborne will cause Pocket to float. Casting AirDash or Flying Cloak will not cancel Barrage.

50.name: Flying Cloak
50.text: Launch a sentient cloak that travels forward and damages enemies. You can press Ability 2 to teleport to its location.

50.name: Enchanter's Satchel
50.text: Escape into your suitcase. When the duration ends, deal spirit damage to nearby enemies. Duration can be ended early by performing any action.

50.name: Affliction
50.text: Applies damage over time to enemies nearby. Affliction's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

52.name: Fire Scarabs
52.text: Infest an enemy with fire scarabs, stealing life from them and causing them to deal reduced damage.

52.name: Dust Devil
52.text: Transform yourself into a whirlwind that travels forward, damaging enemies, slowing their move speed and lifting them up in the air. After emerging from the tornado you gain bullet evasion.

52.name: Djinn's Mark
52.text: Active: Consume all Djinn Marks to deal their damage now.

52.name: Traveler
52.text: Target a location on the minimap. After a brief wait, teleport to that location. Taking damage or being Stunned, Immobilized, put to Sleep or Movement Silenced during the wait period causes the teleport to be interrupted. After teleporting, gain a Barrier.

58.name: Screwjab Dagger
58.text: Throw a dagger, dealing spirit damage and applying slow. Every subsequent dagger against the same target stacks in spirit damage and slow.

58.name: Lethal Venom
58.text: Inject a target with lethal venom. After a delay the venom triggers, dealing Spirit Damage. The damage is increased by the target's missing health. Lethal Venom will ignore Petrify's damage block.

58.name: Slither
58.text: You have increased Slide Distance, can Slide up hills, and can turn faster while Sliding.

58.name: Petrifying Bola
58.text: Throw an explosive bola. On exploding, the bola Slows and Damages all enemies in the area. Direct hits deal Additional Damage and Petrify instead. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.

60.name: Vexing Bolt
60.text: Fire a bolt of magic that deals Damage, increasing as it travels. If you have an Assistant, they also cast Vexing Bolt at reduced damage. Press Ability 1 to redirect the bolt towards your crosshairs.

60.name: Spectral Assistant
60.text: Summon an Assistant at the targeted location. The Assistant attacks whenever you fire your weapon, dealing Damage. While the Assistant is out, you can press Ability 2 to swap positions with your Assistant. Casting Spectral Assistant also reloads your weapon.

60.name: Rabbit Hex
60.text: Hex a target area and transform all enemies into a Rabbit for a limited duration. Rabbits are small and move faster, but take increased Damage and are unable to perform most actions. Hex does not interrupt abilities.

60.name: Audience Participation
60.text: Copy the Ultimate of an enemy hero for a limited time. Reactivating the ability will use the Copied Ultimate instead. Copies will inherit this ability's upgrade points. Audience Participation will also copy the cooldown.

63.name: Sanguine Retreat
63.text: Briefly disperse, becoming untargetable and flying to a target location. Can be recast within a brief window.

63.name: Love Bites
63.text: Your bullets apply additional spirit damage. Dealing damage with your abilities builds up to a vicious bite, dealing a burst of bonus spirit damage. Love Bites has a unique cooldown per target.

63.name: Nox Nostra
63.text: Active: Unleash a cloud of bats that seek out targets, each dealing spirit damage and applying Silence. Passive: Triggering Love Bites against heroes permanently increases the number of bats released.

64.name: Rend
64.text: Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing spirit damage. If the enemy is in close range, deal bonus melee damage.

64.name: Stalker's Mark
64.text: Send out a mark that bleeds the first target it hits, dealing spirit damage over time. While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.

64.name: Eternal Night
64.text: Surround nearby enemy heroes in darkness, severely limiting their vision of other units. Affected enemies are briefly revealed to you and are considered isolated for the duration. You gain bonus sprint speed.

65.name: Consecrating Grenade
65.text: Fire a grenade that bounces before exploding, dealing weapon damage and setting enemies on fire. Burning targets deal pure damage to enemies in the area and suffer from reduced healing.

65.name: Gutshot
65.text: Fire a blast with your shotgun, dealing weapon damage and pushing enemies back. Enemies near a wall receive stun and take bonus weapon damage.

65.name: Hex-Lined Snap Trap
65.text: Kick a trap that arms after a brief delay. The trap springs on the first enemy it touches, dealing spirit damage, applying immobilize, and revealing enemies for a duration afterwards.

65.name: Ira Domini
65.text: Load your crossbow with 3 stakes, dealing massively increased weapon damage. The final stake is blessed, dealing bonus pure damage and executing low-health enemies.

66.name: Pain Battery
66.text: Taking any damage passively charges up your Pain Battery. Once full, activating the ability fires multiple shocking bolts, dealing spirit damage once per target.

66.name: Jumpstart
66.text: Deal spirit damage to yourself. Then, gain bonus regeneration and bonus move speed, decaying over time.

66.name: Aura of Suffering
66.text: Unleash pain, dealing spirit damage over time to both enemies and yourself. The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.

66.name: Shocking Reanimation
66.text: Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing slow. After a brief channel you reanimate, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to nearby enemies.

67.name: Bookwyrm
67.text: Conjure a dragon that appears at the target location before flying forward, dealing spirit damage and leaving a burning path in its trail.

67.name: Plot Armor
67.text: Grant an ally a barrier. While the barrier holds, they gain bonus weapon damage.

67.name: Captivating Read
67.text: Target an area with latent magic, applying slow. The magic detonates after a delay, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize.

67.name: Rallying Charge
67.text: Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city, healing allies and dealing spirit damage to enemies. The strength of the heal and spirit damage is amplified as the knights travel further.

69.name: Call Bell
69.text: Throw out a call bell that deals spirit damage on impact. After a short delay it explodes, dealing additional spirit damage and causing affected enemies to suffer reduced weapon accuracy and movement slow. Can be shot to detonate early.

69.name: Doorway
69.text: Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration. The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.

69.name: Luggage Cart
69.text: Send out a Luggage Cart that deals spirit damage and pulls enemy heroes along its path. Can be alt cast with to target friendly heroes instead.

69.name: Hotel Guest
69.text: Send the target's physical body to be a guest at the Baroness Hotel. The guest is to promptly make their way to the exit elevator, where they'll be sent back to their original position. A stay at the Baroness Hotel is paid for in spirit damage. Failure to check-out on time costs additional spirit damage.

72.name: Bashdown
72.text: Slam your bat into the ground, pulling enemies down and dealing melee damage. The slam creates a shockwave that deals spirit damage and applies knockup.

72.name: Rising Ram
72.text: Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy. Cooldown reduced by 50% on impact.

72.name: Blasted
72.text: Passive: Melee hits restore ammo and inflict wrecked on the victim for 7.0s.

72.name: Chain Gang
72.text: Chain nearby enemies to you. Chained enemies cannot use movement abilities and receive a heavy slow when they pull on the chain. After a delay, yank everyone towards Billy and deal spirit damage. The chain breaks if you lose line of sight for a short while.

76.name: Jar of Dead
76.text: Passive: Collect death when anything dies nearby and store it in your Jar of Dead. Active: Throw a jar to summon Deadheads that repeatedly deal spirit damage to enemies. Deadheads follow you instead if there's no nearby enemies, and prioritize the target of your weapon.

76.name: Grasping Hands
76.text: Unearth a line of grasping hands, summoning a Ghoul and leaving behind a rift. Enemies who pass through take spirit damage and receive immobilize. Alt-Cast rotates the orientation of the wall.

76.name: Essence Theft
76.text: Your weapon steals weapon damage and spirit resist over time, up to a maximum amount per target.

77.name: Disengaging Sigil
77.text: Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.

77.name: Riposte
77.text: Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, immobilizing them, preventing them from parrying, and reducing their Melee Resist. Press Ability 2 to select a target. Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.

77.name: Flawless Advance
77.text: Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage. Press Ability 3 to re-cast.

77.name: Itani Lo Sahn
77.text: Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage, dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies. While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage. Hold Ability 4 or to delay the cast.

78.name: Strix Salvo
78.text: Launch a salvo of spirit missiles that lodge into the ground along a line. The missiles explode after a delay or upon detecting an enemy, dealing spirit damage and marking the target. Shooting a marked enemy with a charged shot consumes a mark to deal bonus spirit damage and apply a fading slow. Hold and drag to select the angle.

78.name: Chimera Mk1
78.text: Hold Jump / mantle to fly, building up heat. When max heat is reached, your jetpack will begin to overheat. Overheating: After a short delay, dive to the ground. Upon impact, create an explosion that deals damage and launches you and nearby enemies. If no hero is hit, you stun yourself. Press Ability 2 to dive early. Cooling Down: After overheating, the jetpack cannot be used until it fully cools down. Slows affect you while airborne. You always explode on death.
tiers: +100 Self Damage Reduction On Player Hit Percent
+50 Overheat Lockout Duration Reduction On Player Hit Percent

78.name: Jettison Fuel
78.text: Spray fuel dealing weapon damage over time and shredding bullet resist, building up to a huge backblast that deals spirit damage and knocks you backwards. Vents the jetpack when dealing damage.

78.name: Close The Deal
78.text: Grab an enemy and give them a hands-on demonstration, flying high into the air before crashing back to the ground. You and the participant take spirit damage over time while falling and spirit damage upon impact. Damage is increased to enemies under 50% health.

79.name: Pillow Toss
79.text: Throw your trusty pillow inflicting spirit damage and heavy knockback. Landing hits reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.

79.name: Tag Along
79.text: Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. Both you and the ally receive a burst heal based on missing health followed by lingering regeneration. Hop between allies with Ability 2 to apply the heal, once per ally. You are knocked off if stunned by an ultimate ability. You can use items and all self-casts target your ally instead.

79.name: Lil Helpers
79.text: Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers. Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of spirit resist and fading move speed. Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team. Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for 15.1s after following someone.

79.name: Naptime
79.text: Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities. When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy spirit damage.

80.name: Slam Fire
80.text: Instantly reload your gun. You gain bonus fire rate and deal bonus weapon damage based on the target's health for a limited number of shots, but suffer from reduced accuracy. Deals bonus Weapon Damage against troopers and neutrals.

80.name: Entangling Bola
80.text: Throw a bola, dealing spirit damage, applying slow and preventing movement abilities or stamina.

80.name: Lycan Curse
80.text: Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health. At max bloodlust, you automatically cast Lycan Curse. Active: Instantly transform, gaining increased max health, and stacking fire rate on enemy heroes, and replacing your abilities and weapon with their ferocious versions.

81.name: Light Eater
81.text: Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal.

81.name: Dazzling Trick
81.text: Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.

81.name: Radiant Daggers
81.text: Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals spirit damage to all targets in the area. Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.

81.name: Shining Wonder
81.text: Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets. Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.

84.name: Scrap Grenade
84.text: Throw a grenade of scrap that detonates multiple times, dealing bullet damage and applying slow. The grenade can be meleed to knock it away.

84.name: Rat Swarm
84.text: Call forth a swarm of rats that leap onto enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and reducing their bullet resist with every bite. The more rats are attached, the faster they will bite the target. Enemies can have multiple rats attached, but can shake off a rat early by performing a ground or air dash.

84.name: Royal Pestments
84.text: Adorn scrappy armor, gaining barrier based on your max health. As long as the armor holds, bullets have a chance to be deflected back towards the attacker. The barrier does not benefit from resists.

84.name: Rule, Ratannia!
84.text: Charge up and summon the banner of Ratannia, granting all nearby allies increased move speed, immunity from slows, and reduced incoming damage while near the banner.

85.name: Setup Bishop
85.text: Create a bishop that remains in place indefinitely. Move ( ): Moves the bishop, applying a fading slow and dealing spirit damage to enemies it passes through. After a delay, activates diagonal squares that deal additional spirit damage when stepped on. Re-activate to recall all bishops, ending the ability.

85.name: Kingside Knight
85.text: Promote an ally to be a knight, granting bonus stamina and barrier for a duration. If self-cast you develop yourself as king instead, granting double the barrier but no stamina. Move ( ): Moves the piece, making it invulnerable during the duration before landing. If self-cast, re-activate the ability to move instead.

85.name: Rook Battery
85.text: Release a pair of rooks that travel forward, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize. If the rooks hit a wall, they reflect back in the opposite direction. Re-Activate : Split the rooks perpendicularly.

86.name: Flow State
86.text: Drag a brush that continues to travel forward, leaving a trail that grants bonus slide distance for allies and a fading slow and spirit damage to enemies it passes through, increased the further it travels. Re-activate the ability to flick the brush forward, ending the ability early but dealing spirit damage in a larger area.

86.name: Still Life
86.text: Choose a hero to be your subject, dealing spirit damage over time as long as you are looking at them. If the sketch is completed they take additional spirit damage, suffer from stun, and drop a sketch that can be picked up. For each collected sketch, you permanently gain stats based on the hero.

86.name: Abstract Landscape
86.text: Create a circular display of ink that blocks vision and grants allies Spirit. Enemies inside are revealed, and leaving causes them to take spirit damage and suffer from Silence and slow, destroying the ink in the process.

87.name: Leech Therapy
87.text: Throw a jar of leeches that attach to enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and eating away at the duration of enemy buffs.
numbers: Buff Duration Drain Per Second: 0.65 s

87.name: Wretched Vapors
87.text: Crack open a vial to release an ethereal vapor onto yourself or an ally that causes a rush, then a crash. Specter Rush: While it lasts, increases the speed of all actions and temporarily numbs all incoming damage creating looming specters. Specter Crash: When the vapors wear off, all actions are slower and any remaining specters deal their delayed damage plus extra damage. Incoming healing will prioritize removing specters first, preventing them from dealing damage.

87.name: Healing Needles
87.text: Load your weapon with a full clip of syringes that heal allies. Dealing damage recovers charges, and each leech you have collected slowly restores them. Reloading spends a charge for a fresh clip. Unused syringes are refunded as a partial charge. Recast to put them away.

87.name: Lurking Terrors
87.text: Open your bag and reveal the horrors you carry inside, dealing spirit damage over time to enemies in front of you. Enemies looking at you build up terror and cannot use stamina or movement abilities. At max terror, they flee in fear away from you. Each leech you have collected adds fear duration. Enemies facing away from you take 50% damage unless feared.

88.name: Threadsap
88.text: Weave a scraggly thread that follows your crosshair before bursting along its path, dealing spirit damage and stealing enemy Spirit, increased in effectiveness for Baba. While holding stolen Spirit, Baba deals bonus spirit damage with every bullet.

88.name: Granny Long Legs
88.text: Your bench's legs extend, granting bonus move speed, higher jumps, Debuff Resistance and Melee Resistance. Light Melee: Perform a kick that knocks enemies back. Heavy Melee: Perform a ground pound that applies knockup, slow, and deals spirit damage. Hold Crouch / slide to charge a high jump, release to jump.

88.name: Baba's Brew
88.text: Brew a pot of tea that applies a magical effect in an area when thrown, cycling over time in a random order between a soothing barrier, Silence, or scalding burn that deals spirit damage over time and reduces spirit resist. Press to pause or resume brewing.

88.name: Feed The Birds
88.text: Cover targets in front of you with bread, adding a stacking slow. When the channel ends a flock of pigeons bombard the targets, dealing spirit damage and hexing each target into a pigeon, increasing in both damage and duration based on bread count.
